MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the fraction 3/4, which number is the denominator? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 4
   C. 1
   D. 3

2. The unit for volume when each block has sides of 1 cm is (1 mark)
   A. litres
   B. cubic centimetres
   C. square centimetres
   D. centimetres

3. How can you test whether a corner is a right angle? (1 mark)
   A. Count its sides
   B. Weigh it
   C. Fit the corner of a folded piece of paper into it
   D. Measure its colour

4. What is 65 ÷ 5? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 23
   C. 13
   D. 12

5. What is 4 h 10 min − 1 h 40 min? (1 mark)
   A. 2 h 30 min
   B. 2 h 20 min
   C. 3 h 30 min
   D. 2 h 40 min

6. What is 5/12 of 24? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 14
   C. 12
   D. 2

7. A customer pays with Ksh 200 for goods that cost Ksh 145. How much change should she get? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 155
   B. Ksh 55
   C. Ksh 345
   D. Ksh 45

8. A cuboid has a volume of 48 blocks. One layer has 8 blocks. How many layers are there? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 56
   C. 7
   D. 6

9. Work out 9,250 − 4,875. (1 mark)
   A. 4,275
   B. 4,385
   C. 5,625
   D. 4,375

10. If k = 3, what is the value of 5k − 2? (1 mark)
   A. 52
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 13

11. A shopping list has three items costing Ksh 650, Ksh 800 and Ksh 1,900. What is the total cost? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 3,360
   B. Ksh 3,350
   C. Ksh 3,250
   D. Ksh 3,450

12. What is 78 ÷ 6? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 23
   D. 14

13. A shop sold 3,275 kg of maize in May and 4,860 kg in June. How many kilograms did it sell altogether? (1 mark)
   A. 8,135 kg
   B. 8,235 kg
   C. 8,125 kg
   D. 7,035 kg

14. What is 2 1/4 kg + 1 1/2 kg? (1 mark)
   A. 3 1/2 kg
   B. 4 kg
   C. 4 1/4 kg
   D. 3 3/4 kg

15. Which Roman numeral stands for 6? (1 mark)
   A. VIIII
   B. VX
   C. VI
   D. IIII

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. A farmer packs 84 mangoes equally into 4 baskets. How many mangoes are in each basket? Then he picks 3 more mangoes. Can he share all 87 mangoes equally among the 4 baskets? Explain. (5 marks)

17. Explain how a quarter turn is related to a right angle and how four quarter turns are related to a full turn. (3 marks)

18. Write an expression for each: (a) 6 less than k, (b) three times a number b, (c) the cost of 5 pens at p shillings each. (3 marks)

19. A learner says that a half turn is the same as two quarter turns. Is the learner right? Explain. (2 marks)

20. Describe the difference between a clockwise and an anticlockwise turn. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 4
   The denominator is the bottom number. It shows how many equal parts the whole is cut into.

2. B — cubic centimetres
   Each block is one cubic centimetre, so volume is measured in cubic centimetres.

3. C — Fit the corner of a folded piece of paper into it
   A folded paper corner is a right angle checker. If it fits exactly, the corner is a right angle.

4. C — 13
   5 × 13 = 65, so 65 ÷ 5 = 13.

5. A — 2 h 30 min
   Change 1 hour to 60 minutes when the minutes are not enough. The answer is 2 h 30 min.

6. A — 10
   24 ÷ 12 = 2 and 2 × 5 = 10. So 5/12 of 24 is 10.

7. B — Ksh 55
   Change = amount paid − cost = 200 − 145 = Ksh 55.

8. D — 6
   Layers = 48 ÷ 8 = 6.

9. D — 4,375
   Subtract from the ones, regrouping when the top digit is smaller. 9,250 − 4,875 = 4,375. Check: 4,375 + 4,875 = 9,250.

10. D — 13
   Replace the letter by its value and work it out. The answer is 13.

11. B — Ksh 3,350
   Add the three costs: 650 + 800 + 1,900 = 3,350.

12. A — 13
   6 × 13 = 78, so 78 ÷ 6 = 13.

13. A — 8,135 kg
   Add 3,275 + 4,860 = 8,135 kg.

14. D — 3 3/4 kg
   Work with the whole kilograms first and then the parts. 2 1/4 kg + 1 1/2 kg = 3 3/4 kg.

15. C — VI
   6 is written VI. Letters after a bigger letter are added.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: 21 mangoes in each basket. 87 ÷ 4 = 21 remainder 3, so he cannot share all 87 equally; 3 will be left over.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 21, 2 marks for 87 ÷ 4 = 21 R 3 with working, 1 mark for answering no, 1 mark for the explanation.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: A quarter turn makes a right angle. Four quarter turns, that is four right angles, make a full turn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for quarter turn = right angle, 1 mark for four quarters, 1 mark for full turn.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) k − 6 (b) 3b (c) 5p
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct expression.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Yes. A half is made of two quarters, so two quarter turns make one half turn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for yes, 1 mark for the reason.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A clockwise turn goes the same way as the hands of a clock. An anticlockwise turn goes the opposite way.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct description.
